hotspawn_rules.picks_lock: 5 minutes before the scheduled start (official how-it-works page). The repo's fixture saves 6 minutes; flagged earlier as RR-03.
hotspawn_rules.points: Points for each correct pick; higher-tier matches give more points; streak bonus for consecutive correct picks. The page does NOT say points depend on how many players chose each side.

FURIA_vs_Aurora_expected_point_cost_of_b.formula: 7 x (p_FURIA - p_Aurora) using de-vigged display prices; ignores the streak bonus, which a wrong pick would lose
FURIA_vs_Aurora_expected_point_cost_of_b.assumption: 7-pt value shown on the Hotspawn card; per-pick formula not published
